steps: form text="Setup Help Appointment schedules Booking-page links the assistant can share, each tied to the calendar that owns its availability. Deleting a row is host-authorized. No appointment schedules yet. Paste a booking page link below to add one. Booking page URL A public Google Calendar appointment-schedule link (calendar.app.google/…) — a share link, not a calendar sync. See the Help tab for how to get one. Calendar No connected calendars yet — connect Google Calendar at /connectors/cinatra-ai/google-calendar-connector/setup to see your calendars here. The Google Calendar this schedule's availability comes from. Leave unset to use your primary calendar. Add schedule"

assertions.detail: no error boundary on the disconnected setup page
